arguments.command:
cd /workspace/dev && cat > fullpipe.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, random, subprocess, sys, time, os
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import stress as st
rng=random.Random(11)
mode=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'torus3d'
sess,q=st.make_session(rng,mode)
req={"version":2,"sessions":[sess]}
raw=json.dumps(req).encode()
print('raw MiB',len(raw)/1048576)
t0=time.time()
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=raw,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
print('rc',r.returncode,'time',round(time.time()-t0,2))
print('stderr',r.stderr.decode()[:2000])
out=r.stdout.decode()
print('stdout MiB',len(out)/1048576)
print(out[:200])
PYEOF
time python3 fullpipe.py torus3d
